testcase.name: nonInteractiveSetupLocalNoInProgressCreatesWorkflowWithoutPickupList

failure.message:
Expecting actual: "Symphony for Trello setup
Checking prerequisites... OK Git OK Java 25+ JDK OK Codex CLI OK Codex CLI authenticated OPTIONAL GitHub CLI authenticated
Validating Trello... OK Connected to Trello as "Alex Example"
Saving Trello credentials... OK Credentials saved: /tmp/junit-5330192231264504188/.env.no-pickup OK Trello API key: **** OK Trello token: toke****
GitHub integration OK GitHub integration skipped symphony-trello setup-local configure-github curl -fsSL https://symphony-trello.fmartin.ch/install.sh | bash OK Trello Workspace: "Engineering"
Trello board OK Board connected: "No Pickup Queue" OK Board lists: "Inbox", "Ready for Codex", "In Progress", "Blocked", "Human Review", "Done" OK Workflow written: /tmp/junit-5330192231264504188/WORKFLOW.no-pickup.md OK Local server port selected for "No Pickup Queue": 20004
Workspace access This controls which files/folders sandboxed card runs may use. Codex execution sandboxing is configured separately. Cards run in per-card workspaces under: ./workspaces OK Additional read/write paths allowed: 0
Codex execution OK Codex sandbox: workspace-limited
Starting Symphony... OK Symphony is connected to "No Pickup Queue"
Board: https://trello.com/b/abc123/board
You're good to go - your Trello board is now a queue for Codex work. Create a Trello card with a clear task and move it to "Ready for Codex". Symphony picks it up, moves it to "In Progress", runs Codex, and keeps the Trello card updated. Review the result and add Trello comments describing what should change. Move the Trello card back to "Ready for Codex" when you want Symphony to address them. If you accept it, move it to "Done". Use `agent.max_concurrent_agents` in `WORKFLOW.md` to control how many cards from this board are processed concurrently.
PS: to add GitHub later, run `symphony-trello setup-local configure-github`. Symphony will add the GitHub PR flow to a connected board, including GitHub-specific Trello lists such as `Merging` when needed. In GitHub mode Symphony can create PRs and link them on the Trello card. `Merging` means: Symphony, please do final checks, merge this PR if safe, and move the Trello card to the configured terminal Trello list.
Read more: Features: https://github.com/martin-francois/symphony-trello#current-capabilities How it works: https://github.com/martin-francois/symphony-trello#how-it-works Concurrency: https://github.com/martin-francois/symphony-trello#workflow-contract " not to contain: "moves it to "In Progress""
